system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"having trouble with family members accepting invite and joining family plan. I moved so canceled account and rejoined family plan with updated address. Still, other family members not able to join."

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! We can help with that. Can you send us a DM with your account's email address so we can check it out? Let us know how it goes! /AI"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Lacks specific guidance on common family plan issues."}
